integrity: The characteristic determinant and all Routh--Hurwitz polynomial inequalities were recomputed with exact integer-polynomial arithmetic by the bundled verifier; no numerical sampling is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result proves local asymptotic stability only for the two-stage model. It neither proves global convergence outside the source's Lyapunov parameter region nor treats three or more infectious stages or transmission from later stages.
title: No local bifurcation of the two-stage endemic equilibrium
